headline: Battle Lines Buckle Across Weathered Expanse
war_summary: The latest returns show the sharpest movement in Weathered Expanse, Mooring County, and Marban Hollow. Weathered Expanse has advanced from five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral bases to six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral, with 70 strategic-base events in 24 hours and three in the latest two-hour window. Mooring County’s disposition remains ten Warden to two Colonial, but activity has intensified to 52 daily events, including three recently, while casualties, enlistments, and both sides’ reported losses are accelerating. Marban Hollow now stands at six Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base; its 17 daily events include six in the latest six-hour stretch, though none in the past two hours. Kuura Strand has become active since the previous edition, recording eight events and sharp recent casualty and enlistment spikes, despite all six bases currently reporting Warden control. Stlican Shelf remains at one Warden and eight Colonial bases after 15 daily events, while Linn Mercy holds at one Warden and ten Colonial bases with two events. Callahan’s Passage has gone quiet in the current window.
